program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((union-cells (remove-duplicates (append (normalize-cells (find-color g 1)) (normalize-cells (find-color g 2)))))
         (bb (bbox-of-cells union-cells)))
    (if bb
        (paint-cells (empty-grid (+ 1 (third bb)) (+ 1 (fourth bb)) 0) union-cells 3)
        (empty-grid 1 1 0))))
